title: Coefficient maps on the dual Koszul complex and conormal determinant
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, f:Fin r -> A a Koszul-regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence] generating I, T a multiplicative submonoid and S its localization. Write g for the image sequence, J=IS, and assume a displayed equality span(g)=J. Let q:A/I -> S/J be a ring map satisfying q(a mod I)=(a in S) mod J. There exist a cochain map chi from the signed dual Koszul complex over A [def-sc-koszul-dual-complex] to the restricted signed dual complex over S and an A-linear map nu between the restricted normal determinants [def-sc-koszul-conormal-comparison]. For every degree n, functional x and n vectors v_i in A^r, evaluation of chi(x) on their image wedge equals the image in S of evaluation of x on their wedge. For every normal determinant w and r vectors v_i, pairing nu(w) with the image conormal wedge equals q applied to the original conormal pairing. No normalized comparison is assumed or compared.

source.place: Lemma 48.15.5, finite free Koszul computation, localization of the coefficient formulas

proof.text: Apply the cochain-map component to obtain chi and its degreewise evaluation formula; apply the independent normal-determinant component to obtain nu and its pairing formula. Pair the two witnesses and their two formulas.

proof_origin.place: B4 stage-3 decomposition into the independent cochain and normal determinant coefficient constructions

theorem exists_koszul_coefficient_extension
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f) (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = I)
    (T : Submonoid A) (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra A S]
    [IsLocalization T S]
    (hs : Ideal.span (Set.range (algebraMap A S ∘ f)) = I.map (algebraMap A S))
    (q : (A ⧸ I) →+* (S ⧸ I.map (algebraMap A S)))
    (hq : ∀ b : A, q (Ideal.Quotient.mk I b) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap A S)) (algebraMap A S b)) :
  ∃ (χ : koszulDualComplex A r f ⟶
    ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap A S)).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj (koszulDualComplex S r (algebraMap A S ∘ f)))
  (ν : koszulNormalDeterminant A I r →ₗ[A]
    (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap A S)).obj
      (koszulNormalDeterminant S (I.map (algebraMap A S)) r)),
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (x : (koszulComplex A r f).X n ⟶ ModuleCat.of A A)
    (v : Fin n → (Fin r →₀ A)),
    (χ.f n x).hom (exteriorPower.ιMulti S n
      (fun i ↦ (v i).mapRange (algebraMap A S) (map_zero _))) =
    algebraMap A S (x.hom (exteriorPower.ιMulti A n v))) ∧
  (∀ (w : koszulNormalDeterminant A I r) (v : Fin r → (Fin r →₀ A)),
    exteriorPower.pairingDual (S ⧸ I.map (algebraMap A S))
      (I.map (algebraMap A S)).Cotangent r (ν w)
      (exteriorPower.ιMulti (S ⧸ I.map (algebraMap A S)) r
        (fun i ↦ koszulConormalVector S (I.map (algebraMap A S)) r
          (algebraMap A S ∘ f) hs
          ((v i).mapRange (algebraMap A S) (map_zero _)))) =
    q (exteriorPower.pairingDual (A ⧸ I) I.Cotangent r w
      (exteriorPower.ιMulti (A ⧸ I) r
        (fun i ↦ koszulConormalVector A I r f hf (v i)))))
